question: Will Iran's exports restart this year, yes or no?

lines.text: Iran's oil minister, Mohsen Paknejad, has resigned, Iranian state media says.
lines.note: Reuters, Arab News, Shafaq: state media, 4 Oct

lines.text: Bloomberg says Iran loaded no crude onto tankers in September, a first since the war began.
lines.note: Shafaq citing Bloomberg: no crude loaded in September, first time since the war began on 28 Feb

lines.text: In August, it was about 250,000 barrels a day.
lines.note: Bloomberg via Shafaq: about 250,000 bpd in August

lines.text: A presidential aide says he quit for personal reasons, a long time ago.
lines.note: Arab News: Mehdi Tabatabaei, communications deputy in the president's office: personal reasons, 'a long time ago'

lines.text: Reuters says the first announcement gave no reason.
President Masoud Pezeshkian accepted it at his insistence, Arab News reports.
The acting minister is Hamid Bovard, head of the National Iranian Oil Company.
Before the news, he said revenues from oil already sold were still coming.
lines.note: Arab News quote: 'revenues of the oil that we have sold are still coming and that will continue God willing'

scene.quote: revenues of the oil that we have sold are still coming

lines.text: Iran faces a US naval blockade and tighter sanctions, Reuters says.
lines.note: Reuters via Shafaq: US naval blockade and intensified sanctions limit oil exports

lines.text: Also today, speaker Ghalibaf said Hormuz stays shut until Iran's seven conditions are met.
lines.note: Daily Sabah, WANA, Al Jazeera, Arab News: Ghalibaf, Islamabad memorandum conditions

lines.text: UKMTO says a tanker in the strait was hit by an unknown projectile. The crew are safe.
lines.note: Daily Sabah citing UKMTO: unknown projectile, crew unharmed, no environmental damage

lines.text: Foreign minister Araghchi: there is no military solution, nor any solution based on new sanctions.

scene.quote: There is no military solution, nor any solution based on new sanctions.

lines.text: No oil loaded, now no oil minister. Will Iran's exports restart this year, yes or no?

caption: Iran's oil minister Mohsen Paknejad has resigned, state media says, after Bloomberg reported Iran loaded no crude onto tankers in September. Hamid Bovard of the National Iranian Oil Company takes over. Will Iran's oil exports restart this year, yes or no?
notes_full: First reported 4 Oct about 11:00 UTC (PressTV), then Iran International 17:06, Reuters 17:34, Arab News, Middle East Eye, Mehr; about 9h old at delivery
No toll, no future-attack framing; Ghalibaf 'new surprises' line deliberately not used
